note: To check with a native speaker: (1) «Buona pesca.» is «Petri Heil.» everywhere, the traditional greeting of German anglers; plainer alternative: «Guten Fang.» (2) Hatch's formula is the German hide-and-seek rhyme «Eckstein, alles muss versteckt sein!» (count, death line, the sheet in his den); alternative closer to the English: «Ob versteckt oder nicht, ich komme!» (3) «die Mutter»: German capitalises every noun, so «Mutter» does not stand out the way «la Madre» does; I kept the article everywhere. (4) «Gazzetta del Golfo» stays Italian (EN translates it; German «Golf» would suggest the sport). (5) HUD hints use the infinitive ("Fisch werfen", "verstecken"), as German games usually do; the radio, deaths and Journal address the player with «du». (6) den_lampy: the source text (IT and EN) says «KG 3,1 – luglio 2003», but per docs/LOCALIZZAZIONE.md the den image now shows «3100 g – 7 / 2003»; I translated the source text («3,1 KG – Juli 2003»). (7) Crayon texts: «FIND MICH!» instead of the draft «FINDE MICH!» (what a child says, and shorter); «ICH HAB HUNGER!» is almost twice as long as «HO FAME!» and will be drawn smaller (shorter fallback: «HUNGER!»). (8) Flyer: the «invito» line has 52 characters (IT 43), so it will be set a little smaller; the tear-off tabs keep the draft's «BEI DÄMMERUNG» because «BEI SONNENUNTERGANG» came out too small; «0 bis 6 Uhr» became «Von 0 bis 6 Uhr» (the right column does not get wider) and «Bar bezahlt im Morgengrauen» became «Barzahlung im Morgengrauen». (9) Catalogue: three names are longer than 16 characters (Unscharfer Drücker, Überspielte Sardine, Klaffender Bonito), two words each. Where I know no German name for the exact species I used the genus or family name: Laternenfisch (Myctophum punctatum), Fliegender Fisch (Cheilopogon heterurus), Gabeldorsch (Phycis phycis), Sägebauch (Hoplostethus mediterraneus), Grenadierfisch (Coelorinchus caelorhincus). Less sure: Mittelmeermakrele (Scomber colias), Schermesser (Xyrichtys novacula), Weißrochen (Rostroraja alba), Silberstreifen-Kugelfisch (Lagocephalus sceleratus), Bläuel (Trachinotus ovatus), Gestreifter Schleimfisch (Parablennius gattorugine), Kleinzahn-Sägerochen (Pristis pectinata). The pronouns in the descriptions follow the grammatical gender of the German name (die Makabrele → sie, der Skeletthecht → er, das Echsengerippe → es).
